title: An approval to re-record one fixture row rewrites every row that differs
foundBy: deps-maintenance pilot2 campaign, whose role definitions had to forbid running `record-fixtures` on a member's own judgement; item 5 of the owner's pilot2 improvements list
details:
`make record-fixtures APPROVE=<id> REASON=<text>` with no `FIXTURES_ARGS` re-records every measured row, and writes each gated `keep` row whose value differs under that one approval. `viewer/fixtures/run.mjs` checks that an approval was given, never which rows it was given for.

Both deps-maintenance pilots ran with seven `keep` rows failing for an unrelated reason: the own ledger had grown from 12 records to 14. An approval meant for one row would have rewritten all eight. The seven frozen values would then be gone, each carrying an approval block that looks legitimate, and nothing would notice.

To reproduce, make two rows differ from `viewer/fixtures/expectations.json` and run `make record-fixtures APPROVE=x REASON=y`. Both rows are rewritten, and the output lists both as approved.
